title: Hyperelliptic period parity with PARI
objective: Replace high-precision per-node mpmath period quadrature with a bounded packed FLINT Arb/Acb batch while preserving independent refinement evidence and measure exact genus-2/3 PARI corpus performance

exceptions: The canonical compiler cannot yet lower variable-precision Arb/Acb values or cached Gauss--Legendre nodes. The narrow bounded bridge mirrors the ordinary Python panel formula, has no host callbacks after entry, retains exact source/differential/PARI oracles, and should become a declared Arb resource or compiler capability when that representation is supported.
